issue_context.title: c8d/exec: `GroupAdd` isn't considered if setting `User`
issue_context.body:
### Description

With the containerd integration enabled, when running a container, extra groups (`docker run --group-add`) are not respected if user (`docker run --user`) is also specified.

### Reproduce

1. `docker run -d --name test --user root:root --group-add staff --group-add wheel --group-add audio --group-add 777 busybox top`
2. `docker exec test id`

### Expected behavior

Expected:
```
uid=0(root) gid=0(root) groups=0(root),10(wheel),29(audio),50(staff),777
```
Actual:
```
uid=0(root) gid=0(root) groups=0(root)
```

(however, if `--user root:root` is omitted from `docker run`, things work as expected)


### Additional Info

This is what's causing `TestDockerSwarmSuite/TestSwarmServiceWithGroup` (https://github.com/moby/moby/actions/runs/6614054276/job/17963338446?pr=46634) to fail.

review_comments:
Somewhat orthogonal to this PR, but looking at the code, I went a bit down the rabbit-hole 🐰 ;

`execSetPlatformOpt` also has a Windows implementation, and it looks like we're currently fully ignoring these options on Windows; disclaimer: perhaps we document these to not be supported, and perhaps we don't support them at the API level; https://github.com/moby/moby/blob/a66ddb7c59781ab4b7d8b931658fa315157bc29b/daemon/exec_windows.go#L11-L16

_However_, I see this function is _also_ stubbed out in containerd; I'm wondering if we should call it in the Windows counterpart (and leave it up to containerd's implementation to do what's needed) ❓ ; it's a bit ambiguous though, because the comment describes LCOW (not "WCOW" :thinking:)
https://github.com/moby/moby/blob/a66ddb7c59781ab4b7d8b931658fa315157bc29b/vendor/github.com/containerd/containerd/oci/spec_opts.go#L812-L820

Further down the rabbit-hole; the `WithUser` and `WithUIDGID` functions look really scary, as they **unconditionally reset `AdditionalGids`** that means that _order of these options matters_. ⚠️ 
https://github.com/moby/moby/blob/a66ddb7c59781ab4b7d8b931658fa315157bc29b/vendor/github.com/containerd/containerd/oci/spec_opts.go#L594-L602
https://github.com/moby/moby/blob/a66ddb7c59781ab4b7d8b931658fa315157bc29b/vendor/github.com/containerd/containerd/oci/spec_opts.go#L697-L702

- On our side, we should consider adding a comment; it's currently somewhat clear because we _also_ call our own `withResetAdditionalGIDs` (which resets the field)
- ^^ but (looking at the code above), it looks like that function is redundant, so we can remove it (?)
- We should contribute a patch to containerd to _at least_ update the GoDoc for these functions to call that out
- _Perhaps_ consider making it an error-condition when setting a `User` and `AdditionalGids` is _not empty_ (?)

Note: we had to reset the additional GIDs because containerd didn't do it at the time this was implemented, containerd changed its implementation since, was added here: https://github.com/moby/moby/commit/174802e15f12ee4384c7672676247aaf28997f76#diff-ebde8092f4da3b1f60a5d5b7d805276d2c831362b528c385e8792a9168a34444

So yeah, we can remove this call now I guess, maybe in a new PR

> So yeah, we can remove this call now I guess, maybe in a new PR

Will do! :)

> Further down the rabbit-hole; the `WithUser` and `WithUIDGID` functions look really scary, as they unconditionally reset AdditionalGids that means that order of these options matters. ⚠️

But we don't call `WithUIDGID` anywhere, right? Or do you mean this re: calling it out in the Godoc in containerd?

> Perhaps consider making it an error-condition when setting a User and AdditionalGids is not empty (?)

In `WithUser`, or on our side?

> In `WithUser`, or on our side?

In another PR :) And surely with an issue so that we can discuss about this in a more approriate place

This function (and also other `WithUser`/`With*GID`) mounts the container snapshot in a read-only mode:
https://github.com/moby/moby/blob/a66ddb7c59781ab4b7d8b931658fa315157bc29b/vendor/github.com/containerd/containerd/oci/spec_opts.go#L750-L754

which is undefined behavior for overlayfs when a directory is also mounted as a work-dir of other mount.

And this condition is true in this case, because for `exec`, the container will already be running and so the container snapshot (with container working layer) is already mounted.

This is not a new problem though, because this is already happening in the other `WithAdditionalGIDs`.
We (@laurazard did) fixed this in containerd https://github.com/containerd/containerd/pull/8299

Ah, I missed that this removes the work-dir completely, instead of just moving to the lower-dir.
~That solves the issue I think, although that probably means that changes to `/etc/passwd` after the container started won't be picked up by this code? It's probably not a big problem though.~
Why wouldn't they be picked up?

Ah, nevermind, I'm talking nonsense, the upperdir is still in the lower-dir.

In that case, I think the readonly mount will still cause undefined behavior because we mount the container rw-layer (which is an upper-dir of the other mount) as lower-dir.

BUT! It's actually not going to happen there, because we don't even hit this mount code.
We don't even set the `Snapshotter` and `SnapshotterKey` for exec so it will end up taking this branch:
https://github.com/moby/moby/blob/a66ddb7c59781ab4b7d8b931658fa315157bc29b/vendor/github.com/containerd/containerd/oci/spec_opts.go#L732-L736

and will just use the `s.Root.Path` directly.

So, it's fine in this case, but we must remember about it if at some point in future we set `Snapshotter` and `SnapshotterKey` in exec config.

> So, it's fine in this case, but we must remember about it if at some point in future we set Snapshotter and SnapshotterKey in exec config.

@vvoland can you create a ticket for this if changes are needed somewhere? (this repo and/or containerd)?

Yeah, we will always only set the root path since we are the ones doing the mounting (so that we can reference count things)

But we did set the `Snapshotter` in the past https://github.com/moby/moby/pull/45698/files#diff-034d55db8b341bd127a5394a84226b04c91d54669dd856051ceb0bcbbb50b380L182

Ah, In this case, everything is good :) 
Thanks for the explanation!
